children: "If you look at a control premium, it's generally 20 to 30%... In order to make sure this is fair for Tesla shareholders, I actually think they'll err on the side of a higher change in control here because they need to make sure, they want to guard against the lawsuits that invariably come.... I think you're going to see something between $420 a share and let's call it $520 or $550 a share."
Brad Gerstner, Altimeter Capital CEO, speaking on CNBC today.
